name: CanvasTTY Environments
description: Where a card runs: its own git worktree, a server over ssh, or a Docker/Podman container here or on a server; Collect changes brings the work home, and capsule checks run a saved check on a snapshot of it.
description.ru: Где работает окно: в своём git worktree, на сервере по ssh или в контейнере Docker/Podman здесь или на сервере; «Collect changes» забирает работу домой, а проверки в капсуле запускают сохранённую проверку на снимке работы.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

modules.title: Git worktree
modules.description: Runs a card in its own git worktree (a branch in its own folder, in the plugin's data folder); removed on close unless you keep it.

modules.title: SSH server
modules.description: Runs a card on a server you configure (label, ssh alias or host, user, folder mapping) through your own ssh config and agent. No keys are stored.

modules.title: Container
modules.description: Runs a card in a Docker or Podman container here: an existing image, /workspace = an owned copy or the project, no network by default, read-only root, no capabilities, limits checked from inside; restore restarts it.

modules.title: Container on a server
modules.description: The same container on a server from the ssh-host settings (Podman by default), created, checked and started over ssh. Nothing from this computer is forwarded into it.

modules.title: Collect changes and capsule checks
modules.description: Collect changes brings a worktree, server or container card's work home as a local branch; capsule checks run the saved check on a snapshot in an isolated container and apply a passed one as a branch.

services.title: Git worktree
services.description: Creates, reopens and removes git worktrees for cards started in this environment.

environments.label: Git worktree
environments.description: A branch in its own folder; the project folder stays untouched.

services.title: SSH server
services.description: Runs cards on a configured server over ssh; checks the server is reachable before starting and on restore.

environments.label: SSH server
environments.description: Runs on a server from the plugin's settings, in the folder mapped to this project.

services.title: Container
services.description: Creates, checks, restarts and removes a local Docker or Podman container for cards started in it.

environments.label: Container
environments.description: A Docker or Podman container on this computer; /workspace is a copy of the project or the project itself.

options.label: A copy (git worktree; Collect changes brings it home)

services.title: Container on a server
services.description: Creates, checks, restarts and removes a container on a configured server over ssh.

environments.label: Container on a server
environments.description: A container on a server from Settings, in the folder mapped to this project (or a copy of it).

options.label: A copy (git worktree; Collect changes brings it home)

services.title: Collect changes and capsule checks
services.description: Brings a card's changes home as a local branch; runs the saved check on a snapshot in an isolated container.

tools.name: collect
tools.description: Bring the changes of one of your subagents (or your own card) that runs in a worktree, on an ssh server or in a container home as a new local branch canvastty/<id>-<title>. Credential files are left out; nothing is merged and the current branch is not touched. Collect each finished subagent, then merge the branches.

sessionId.description: A subagent of yours; omit for your own card.

tools.name: capsule
tools.description: Capsule checks on your own card or one of your subagents that works on this computer (worktree, container or the project folder): action run (default) snapshots its working tree and runs the check command from the plugin's settings in an isolated container without network, answering pass/fail and the log tail (or 'running' after 13 s; then call with action result); action apply turns a passed snapshot into a new local branch canvastty/<id>-<title>-checked. Nothing is merged and the current branch is not touched.

sessionId.description: A subagent of yours; omit for your own card.

contributions.title: Settings
contributions.description: Servers and folder mappings (ssh-host, containers on a server), and container settings (engine, image, limits, check command).
